metadata.name: PaymentScheduleDelete
metadata.description: Purpose of this webhook is triggered when a new payment schedule is deleted from an account.

request_fields.name: InfoAlert
request_fields.description: Group of fields passed in webhook

request_fields.name: Tab
request_fields.description:
Indicates tab in system under which this webhook is available
Valid Values:Status, Period, Monetary, Security and Cards Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: Category
request_fields.description: Indicates category of alert triggered Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: SubCategory
request_fields.description: Indicates subcategory of Category of alert triggered Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: FirstName
request_fields.description: First name of Account holder Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: LastName
request_fields.description: Last Name of Account holder Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: AvailableOTB
request_fields.description: Amount available for further purchases on Account

request_fields.name: PrimaryEmail
request_fields.description: Email ID of Primary cardholder. This field is available only when AlertRecipientType is 1 or 3 or 5 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CosignerEmailID
request_fields.description: Email ID of Cosigner on account. This field is available only when AlertRecipientType is 2 or 3 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: BankAccountLast4Digit
request_fields.description: Last 4 digits of the bank account thatwas selected while setting up the payment schedule. Allowable Values: 4

request_fields.name: XAmount
request_fields.description: Amount for which payment schedule was created. This field is available only when PaymentScheduleType is Fixed Amount.

request_fields.name: PaymentScheduleType
request_fields.description:
Indicates type of payment for which payment schedule was Added. 
alid values: Statement Balance or Minimum Due or Fixed Amount or Current Balance Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: PaymentScheduleDate
request_fields.description: Date when payment schedule was Added(FORMAT: YYYYMMDD)

request_fields.name: BankName
request_fields.description: Indicates the name of the bank associated with the account used to set up the payment schedule. Allowable Values: 70

request_fields.name: ScheduleID
request_fields.description: Provides a unique identifier for payment schedule that has been deleted from the system Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: PaymentScheduleFrequency
request_fields.description: Indicates Frequency with which paymentschedule was added Possible values: Monthly Specific Day, Payment Due Date, One Time, Weekly Allowable Values: 30

request_fields.name: BankMethodName
request_fields.description: Unique identifier of the bank account in the CoreCard system that was used to create the now-deleted payment schedule. Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrentBalance
request_fields.description: Current Balance of Account

request_fields.name: PaymentTransactionID
request_fields.description:
Unique identifier for Transaction ID of payment return which
triggered deletion of payment schedule.This field is not available
when PaymentScheduleFrequency is One Time Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: AlertRecipientType
request_fields.description:
Type of recipient to which alert needs to be sent
1: - Primary Applicant 
2: - Cosigner 
3:- Applicant and Cosigner 
4:- Auth User 
5:- Applicant and Auth User

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description:
Card Holder Account Number
Valid Values: 0-9
Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX
Example: 8000000000000037 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description:
Admin Number associated with the event
Valid Values:0-9
Format:XXXXX
Example:12345

request_fields.name: RequestID
request_fields.description:
Primary Key for API
Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX
Example:12345 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: Mode
request_fields.description: Indicates the type of activity performed which triggered this webhook Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: AccountUniversalUniqueID
request_fields.description:
Universal Unique ID for Account
Format:XXXXXXXXXX
Example:9894f28b-d051-4eaa-9e48-a3a7d5b4a6f7 Allowable Values: 64

request_fields.name: CardUniversalUniqueID
request_fields.description:
Universal Unique ID for Admin
Format:XXXXXXXXXX
Example:9894f28b-d051-4eaa-9e48-a3a7d5b4a6f7 Allowable Values: 64

request_fields.name: ClientID
request_fields.description:
Corecard's Client ID
Valid Values: 0-9
Format: XXXXX
Example: 578455 Allowable Values: 64

request_fields.name: RequestUniversalUniqueID
request_fields.description:
UniversalUniqueID Request
Valid Values: 0-9 A-Z
Example: 8638-b87b-48d0-8e13-0ebb5643577 Allowable Values: 64

request_fields.name: User
request_fields.description:
User ID of the user who triggered the webhook event. 
Valid Values: CoreCredit user, API user, System Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: DateandTime
request_fields.description:
Timestamp when notification was sent
MM-DD-YYYY hh:mm:ss:sss 
(24-hour Format) 
Exception: For Auth Age Off alert the format of this tag is "YYYY-MM-DD 
hh:mm:ss.SSS

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description:
Indicates the source from where the activity was performed by user or triggered by system.
Valid Values: CoreCredit, External API, Self Service, CoreCollect, IVR, System, CoreIssue Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ServiceName
request_fields.description:
Name of API service (webhook) triggered
Example: svcName Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: AlertType
request_fields.description:
Indicates type of Alert
Valid Values:RealTime or Re Try (due to time-out) Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: TransactionSource
request_fields.description:
Transaction Source of transaction
Valid Values:IPM, Retail Manual Auth-Installment, Retail Manual Auth-Revolver etc. Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: InstitutionID
request_fields.description: A unique identifier assigned by Corecard for Institution

request_fields.name: ProductID
request_fields.description: A unique identifier assigned by Corecard for Product

request_fields.name: AlertRecipientType
request_fields.description:
Type of recipient to which alert needs to be sent
Valid Values:1=Primary Applicant,2=Cosigner,3=Applicant and Cosigner,4=Auth User,5=Applicant and Auth User
